notes: The second לְ (s008) is unrepresented because the ASV writes only one for; rule 33's distributed repetition needs a preposition written again over the later member, and here the later member is the one whose preposition the Hebrew writes.
בַּמֶּה is fused to wherein/wherewith's counterpart wherewith under rule 30, headed on the interrogative carrying the wh-lexeme.
